cheezious.title: Cheezious
cheezious.yt_title: How Cheezious went from Okara to 30,000 pizzas a day #cheezious
cheezious.caption_en: Two friends, one small pizza shop in Okara, and a crown-shaped crust. #cheezious #pizza #pakistan #qissamukhtasar

ainak_wala_jin.title: Ainak Wala Jin (PTV)
ainak_wala_jin.hook: Mujhe kaam batao! Main kya karun? Main kis ko khaun?
ainak_wala_jin.yt_title: What happened to the cast of Ainak Wala Jin? #ainakwalajin
ainak_wala_jin.caption_en: The genie everyone remembers, and the people behind it. #ainakwalajin #ptv #90s #pakistan #qissamukhtasar

paktel.title: Paktel
paktel.hook: Zong ka asal naam kya tha?
paktel.yt_title: Zong's forgotten first name: the story of Paktel #paktel
paktel.caption_en: In 1990 Paktel was one of Pakistan's first mobile networks. In 2007 China Mobile bought it, and a year later Paktel became Zong. #paktel #zong #pakistantelecom #nostalgia #qissamukhtasar

haleeb.title: Haleeb milk
haleeb.hook: Kabhi Pakistan mein har doosra dabba doodh, Haleeb ka tha.
haleeb.yt_title: What really happened to Haleeb milk? #haleeb
haleeb.caption_en: Once every second pack of milk in Pakistan was Haleeb. Then Olper's arrived, and the king of the fridge went quiet. #haleeb #pakistanibrands #nostalgia #dairy #qissamukhtasar

hardees.title: Hardee's Pakistan
hardees.hook: Paanch saal mein pachees restaurant. Yeh tha Hardee's ka Pakistan se waada.
hardees.yt_title: Hardee's came to Pakistan with a big promise. What happened next? #hardees
hardees.caption_en: In 2009 Hardee's promised Pakistan 25 restaurants in five years. Someone said it would shut in a month. It took longer, but it got there. #hardees #lahore #fastfood #pakistanibrands #qissamukhtasar

second_cup.title: Second Cup and Pakistan's first cafés
second_cup.hook: Tees cafe kholne ka plan tha. Aaj aik bhi nahin bacha.
second_cup.yt_title: Pakistan's first café craze: who survived? #secondcup
second_cup.caption_en: Copper Kettle, Espresso, Café Coffee Day... Pakistan's first café wave, the chains that faded, and the Canadian name that kept growing. #secondcup #karachi #coffeeculture #nostalgia #qissamukhtasar

polka.title: Polka ice cream
polka.yt_title: What really happened to Polka ice cream? #polka
polka.caption_en: Polka turned down Rs600 million in 1994. Two years later Unilever owned it, and the cup became Wall's. #polka #walls #icecream #90skids #qissamukhtasar

bp_spacer.title: BP Spacer toffee
bp_spacer.hook: Doodh aur chocolate... aik hi lambi si toffee mein. Yaad hai?
bp_spacer.yt_title: Whatever happened to BP Spacer toffee? #bpspacer
bp_spacer.caption_en: Milk and chocolate in one long bar you folded into your mouth. BP Spacer, from a company set up in 1948, was still made in 2013. Then many of us stopped seeing it. #bpspacer #90skids #pakistaninostalgia #pakistanibrands #qissamukhtasar

pakola.title: Pakola
pakola.hook: Hari botal... aur zaa'iqa, ice cream ka!
pakola.yt_title: The untold story of Pakola, Pakistan's green ice-cream soda #pakola
pakola.caption_en: Launched on 14 August 1950 with Liaquat Ali Khan in attendance, nearly killed by a tax in 2013, and still the taste of home for Pakistanis abroad. #pakola #pakistanibrands #karachi #nostalgia #qissamukhtasar

shezan.title: Shezan
shezan.hook: Aik saal mein chhiyaalees crore ka nuqsaan. Aur aglay saal... record sale!
shezan.yt_title: Shezan: from a Rs46 crore loss to record sales #shezan
shezan.caption_en: A loss in the first boycott year, then sales above Rs9 billion for the first time and profit more than doubling. How a Lahore company founded in 1964 got its breath back. #shezan #pakistanibrands #boycott #business #qissamukhtasar

hico.title: Hico ice cream
hico.hook: Ice cream market mein aik company ka hissa? Sirf do feesad.
hico.yt_title: The 2% ice cream that took on Walls and Omore #hico
hico.caption_en: From tricycle hawkers in Lahore to a factory, and a competition case that said frozen dessert isn't ice cream. The story of Hico. #hico #icecream #lahore #pakistanibrands #qissamukhtasar

gourmet.title: Gourmet
gourmet.hook: Aik chhoti si dukaan... aur aaj apni cola, aur apna news channel!
gourmet.yt_title: From one Lahore shop to a cola and a TV channel: Gourmet's empire #gourmet
gourmet.caption_en: One confectionery shop in Lahore in 1987. Today 100+ stores in the city, its own cola and a news channel. #gourmet #gourmetcola #lahore #pakistanibrands #qissamukhtasar

savour.title: Savour Foods
savour.hook: Kaha jata hai, yeh saltanat sirf atharah kursiyon se shuru hui thi.
savour.yt_title: How 18 chairs in Pindi became Savour Foods' pulao empire #savourfoods
savour.caption_en: A pulao cart near Gordon College, one dish, one rule, and lines that never got shorter. #savourfoods #rawalpindi #pulao #pakistanibrands #qissamukhtasar

howdy.title: Howdy
howdy.hook: Barah, barah, barah... aur burger ki ek nayi kahani.
howdy.yt_title: How Howdy turned burgers into a hangout #howdy
howdy.caption_en: Cowboy hats, barrel tables and charcoal smoke: the Lahore burger joint that sold a place to sit, not just a bun. #howdy #burgers #lahore #pakistanibrands #qissamukhtasar

cola_next.title: Cola Next
cola_next.hook: Ek Pakistani cola, jis ki factories demand poori nahin kar pa rahi thin.
cola_next.yt_title: The Pakistani cola that couldn't keep up with demand #colanext
cola_next.caption_en: A small local cola, a nationwide boycott, and a new slogan: 'Because Cola Next is Pakistani.' Can feelings keep a brand going? #colanext #pakistan #cola #pakistanibrands #qissamukhtasar

optp.title: OPTP
optp.hook: Ek aaloo, do aaloo... aur ek poori fast food chain.
optp.yt_title: How OPTP turned fries into a whole chain #optp
optp.caption_en: Two brothers in Karachi, a lot of test potatoes, and a menu where the fries were the hero. #optp #fries #karachi #pakistanibrands #qissamukhtasar

bundu_khan.title: Bundu Khan
bundu_khan.hook: Bundu Khan... yeh naam aap ke shehar mein bhi hai?
bundu_khan.yt_title: Bundu Khan: the BBQ name every city claims #bundukhan
bundu_khan.caption_en: A 1948 barbecue stall on Karachi's Bandar Road became a name you now see in many cities, and even in a US courtroom. #bundukhan #karachi #bbq #pakistanibrands #qissamukhtasar

kababjees.title: Kababjees
kababjees.hook: Kababon ka aik restaurant... aur log pooch rahe hain, Kababjees airline kab aaye gi?
kababjees.yt_title: How a Karachi kabab restaurant became the Kababjees empire #kababjees
kababjees.caption_en: One kabab restaurant by the sea, then a bakery, fried chicken and 12 outlets. No wonder Karachi jokes about a Kababjees airline. #kababjees #karachi #karachifood #pakistanibrands #qissamukhtasar

burger_oclock.title: Burger O'Clock
burger_oclock.hook: Donut ke bun, beech mein Nutella... aur ise kaha gaya burger!
burger_oclock.yt_title: How Burger O'Clock went from a donut burger to two cities #burgeroclock
burger_oclock.caption_en: A tiny Karachi shop, a Nutella burger on donut buns, and ten years later two cities. #burgeroclock #karachi #lahore #pakistanibrands #qissamukhtasar

jalal_sons.title: Jalal Sons
jalal_sons.hook: Pakistan ko bane bas aik saal hua tha... jab Lahore mein aik dukaan khuli.
jalal_sons.yt_title: How Jalal Sons went from an Old Lahore shop to 20+ branches #jalalsons
jalal_sons.caption_en: A small shop in Ghumti Bazar in 1948, a move to Gulberg in 1958, and live baking that changed Lahore's bakeries. #jalalsons #lahore #bakery #pakistanibrands #qissamukhtasar

dananeer_mobeen.title: Dananeer Mobeen
dananeer_mobeen.hook: Yeh hamari car hai... aur yeh hamari pawri ho rahi hai!
dananeer_mobeen.yt_title: How the 'Pawri Ho Rahi Hai' girl became an award-winning actor #dananeermobeen
dananeer_mobeen.caption_en: A few seconds on Instagram in 2021 made her famous on both sides of the border. Her work since then made it last. #dananeermobeen #pawrihorahihai #pakistanidrama #qissamukhtasar
